best_for: New professionals entering the corporate world
Team members wanting to improve internal communication
not_for: Advanced corporate executives looking for high-level negotiation

overview.positioning: Learn the essential written and operational communication skills for the modern workplace.
overview.short_description: A quick, focused course on writing better emails, using Slack/Teams effectively, and managing daily corporate communication tools.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Communicate professionally on instant messaging platforms like Slack.
Draft simple business memos and updates in Google Docs/Notion.

why_now.industry_shift: Remote work relies heavily on asynchronous written communication.
why_now.ai_impact: AI can draft content, but structuring it for human consumption is vital.
why_now.business_demand: Poor communication causes delays and mistakes in fast-paced environments.
why_now.career_opportunity: Efficient communicators are seen as reliable and professional.

learning_outcomes: DRAFT: Effective emails that get responses.

stages.focus: Writing clear emails with strong subject lines.
Writing memos and updates in Notion/Docs.

industry_workflow.overview: Daily communication operations in a business.

stages.name: Determine Channel
stages.desc: Deciding whether to use email, chat, or a document.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Information lost in messy Slack channels.

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Choosing the right medium for sensitive topics.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Review AI drafts to ensure they don't sound robotic.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Use AI for speed, but personalize messages.

best_practices: BLUF: Bottom Line Up Front in emails.
Use threads in Slack to keep channels clean.

common_mistakes.mistake: Sending an email for something that requires a 2-minute chat.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Match the medium to the urgency and complexity.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Review tools -> Create guidelines -> Manage comms

what_you_will_build: A library of 10 essential business email templates.

assessment.criteria: Clarity, tone, and appropriate tool usage.

faq.question: Is this course about speaking or writing?
faq.answer: This micro-course focuses primarily on written and operational communication (emails, Slack, Docs).

modules.module_purpose: Learn to write emails that are read and acted upon.

lessons.lesson_title: The Anatomy of a Perfect Email
lessons.what_is_taught: Subject lines, greetings, body, and sign-offs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Format a disorganized email into a proper structure.

lessons.what_is_taught: Putting the main point or request in the first sentence.
lessons.what_learner_does: Rewrite long emails to feature the BLUF.
Draft emails for sensitive situations (e.g., declining a request).

modules.assignment: Create a toolkit of 5 email templates (intro, follow-up, apology, request, update).
modules.business_application: Faster email turnaround and better responses.

modules.module_purpose: Navigate Slack, Teams, and documentation effectively.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using threads, mentions (@), and status updates.
lessons.why_it_matters: Prevents notification fatigue for the team.
lessons.what_learner_does: Simulate resolving an issue in a chat thread.

lessons.what_is_taught: Drafting clear project updates and meeting notes.
lessons.why_it_matters: Creates a permanent record of work.
lessons.what_learner_does: Draft a brief project update in Google Docs.

lessons.what_is_taught: When to use email vs. chat vs. document vs. meeting.
lessons.what_learner_does: Analyze scenarios and select the best communication tool.

modules.assignment: Draft a 'Team Communication Guideline' document in Notion.
modules.expected_outcome: Mastery of modern corporate communication tools.
